$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

Actionability.description: The definition 2 member (spec 033, 3.1.1). Each list may be empty.

Address.description:
Where an outcome is addressed: computed from its causes (when omitted),
or an override toward a party less able to act (3.5.3).

Adjustment.description: Raises a proposal parameter one position on an ordered scale, saturating.

BackendReq.description: Declared backend requirements beyond the operation and value kind.

BindingChoice.description: An explicit binding makes that backend the only candidate (3.9.4).

subject.description: The declared input whose provenance the check branches on.

test.description: A `bool` predicate over inputs, `now` and literals.

oneOf.description:
True when the referenced value's provenance is within `classes`
(spec 033, 3.4.7).

Consequence.description:
What a failed check does (3.3). `refuse`, `abstain` and `escalate` are
terminal; the others are field-level.

ConstraintGroup.description: A named group of checks a `relax` consequence switches off (3.3.3).

claim.description: An input path or step value.

DefaultConsequence.description: A check's `default`: the string `none`, or a consequence.

Delay.description: The delay before retry `n` (1-based). No jitter.

oneOf.description: `initial_ms`, doubling per retry, capped at `max_ms`.

Determinism.description: Declared determinism of a backend, weakest first.

Disagreement.description:
The conflict policy of a graded input (spec 032, 3.8). There is no
recency rule: entry order never chooses a value.

caps.description: Lower the ceiling of a path and its descendants; never raise.

ExactDecl.description:
An exact step: a registry operator, its version and its arguments. The
arguments are decoded against the operator's own schema by the compiler,
so an unknown operator is refused as `unknown_operator`, not as a parse
failure (spec 002, 3.9.5).

Expr.description:
Expressions inside exact-operator arguments and policy predicates
(registry `rustev.exact/1`). References are `input:<name>`,
`step:<id>`, `item:<field>[.<field>...]` (inside a per-item operator) and
`now`.

oneOf.description: Decimal product rounded half-even to 10^-9; integers are exact.
Decimal quotient rounded half-even to 10^-9.
Rescale a decimal half-even to `scale` digits.
Currency conversion through a rate table (`fx_convert@1` semantics).
Length of a list.
Integer to decimal, the only numeric conversion.

Registry `rustev.exact/2`: a reference with a grade requirement
(spec 032, 3.9.1).

FailureClass.description:
How a dispatched attempt failed (spec 003, 3.6.1). Deadline and
cancellation are not classes: they end a request, and are never retried
or a fallback trigger.

oneOf.description: The output failed the core's validation.
The adapter says the failure may not recur.
The adapter says the backend refused for load.
The adapter says the failure will recur for this input.
The attempt timeout passed.
The adapter panicked.

Fallback.description: What happens when no candidate satisfies the step (3.9.6).

oneOf.description: The step is always `unsupported{capability}`.
Bind with this alternative required kind instead.

ForEach.description: Fan-out over the ids produced by a step.

bind.description: The name the instance key carries; `bind:<name>` projects its item.

items.description: Where the item record for each id comes from, if it is projected.

over.description: `step:<id>` whose result is an id list, a filter result or a shortlist.

Freshness.description: How old an input may be at evaluation time.

Grade.description:
The closed, ordered evidence grade. The derived order runs weakest to
strongest, so `min` and `max` are the grade order of spec 032, 3.2.1.

oneOf.description:
A label from a source declared unreliable for that field, or a
constructed key not yet corroborated.
A computed or crawled approximation that never was authoritative.
Was authoritative at its as-of time and has not been revalidated.
Live, attested by the system that owns the fact.

Handler.description: Handles one input or step being unresolved.

oneOf.description: The judgment is the target's unresolved reason.

Atomic conditions reading the target are false; a rule whose outcome
reads it does not match.

`propagate` with a declared remediation or address override (spec
033, 3.5.5).
The caller is asked for these fields (spec 033, 3.7).

evidence.description:
Version 2: the sources that grade this input (spec 032, 3.3.3);
an input without it is ungraded.

on_disagreement.description:
Version 2: how disagreeing entries are resolved (spec 032, 3.8);
omitted means `require_agreement`.

provenance.description: The provenance classes this input accepts; non-empty.

oneOf.description: A list of records (`input:<name>`) and the text field holding the id.

acquisition.description: Spec 036 acquisition ceilings, omitted when unused.

deadline_ms.description: Recorded for the runtime; not enforced by the pure core.

OutcomeDecl.description: What a matching rule proposes. Never a grant (spec 001, 3.2).

oneOf.description: `missing_evidence` naming the fields listed by a step.
The caller is asked for these fields (spec 033, 3.7).

Party.description:
Who can act on an outcome (3.5.2), ordered from most to least able to
act on it themselves: the combination of parties is the greatest.

Predicate.description: Boolean predicates. `all([])` is true; `any([])` is false.

oneOf.description: True when the named input resolved (`input:<name>`).
Registry 2: whether the referenced value was constructed (spec 036).

Registry `rustev.exact/2`: true when the value is a member of the
list, or the keys of the map, `set` references (spec 032, 3.7.2).

PresentWhen.description:
A record presence predicate (spec 032, 3.4.2). Each list is non-empty;
the canonical form sorts and deduplicates every field list.

ProvenanceClass.description: The closed set of provenance classes (spec 002, 3.7.1).

fields.description: A non-empty subset of the outcome's fields.

text.description: 1 to 1024 bytes of UTF-8, carried byte-identical; no interpolation.

QuestionSelection.description:
Declared questions, optionally selected by an accepted extraction (spec 038, 3.13).
The list encoding preserves existing definition and plan bytes.

ReasonKind.description: The names of the closed `Unresolved` reasons.

oneOf.description: Present but below a required grade (spec 032, 3.9.4).
A declared skipped path, distinct from an unresolved failure.

RemediationUse.description:
A use of a declared or built-in remediation: its code alone, or its
code with parameters (3.6.3).

RequiredKind.description: The value kind a semantic step requires (spec 002, 3.9.3).

ScreeningEntry.description: An authored entry. Every member is required, including explicit policies.

SemanticDecl.description: A question answered by a decision backend.

candidates.description: For rank: the step whose id list is ranked.

for_each.description: Zero, one or two id lists this step fans out over.

options.description:
Labels (classify), `["false", "true"]` (proposition), levels from low to
high (rubric); empty for rank.

question.description: The question or statement put to the backend.

task.description: The task identity a calibration binds to.

oneOf.description: Version 2: the only way a grade rises (spec 032, 3.7).

StepDecl.description: One step of the plan graph.

TypeDecl.description: Input value types (spec 002, 3.7.2). Every record field is required.

present_when.description: Version 2: when a decoded record is present (spec 032, 3.4.2).

oneOf.description:
Version 2, record fields only: JSON `null` or a missing key, stored
as `null` (spec 032, 3.4.1).
Version 2: a JSON object with text keys (spec 032, 3.4.1).

UncalibratedThreshold.description: Whether a probability threshold may read an uncalibrated distribution.

description: A versioned, authored description of a recurring decision.

actionability.description:
Version 2: provenance-conditional checks and actionable outcomes
(spec 033, 3.1.1); omitted when unused.

screening.description: Optional screening contract (spec 035); omitted when unused.
